title: The gap step's weak-lead rule rejects on-kb questions whose subject is only in the lead's body
goal: ql_apply.weak_off_topic keeps a weak gap candidate whose lead article covers the question's subject in its body, not only its topic or title: the live queue question 'cargo metadata --no-deps invokes rustc .cargo/config.toml build.rustc' (F-68c59a20a679, lead agents/codebase-mapping) is not rejected, a test proves it, the email-attachment rejection still holds, and rag.py eval still passes (found in the SP-4slunkaj review)

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import kbfacts, ql_apply; from ql_learn import domain_article; g=ql_apply.Gate(); r=kbfacts.pack('cargo metadata --no-deps invokes rustc .cargo/config.toml build.rustc', fmt='concise'); sys.exit(ql_apply.weak_off_topic(r, domain_article(r, g.article_of), g))
